hints.title: Greedy Selection
hints.text: To minimize the total sum, always greedily pick the smallest available positive integers.

hints.title: Conflict Prohibition
hints.text: If integer x is selected, integer target - x cannot be selected. Therefore, for pairs that sum to target, we can only take the smaller half.

hints.title: Range Arithmetic
hints.text: Pick integers from 1 up to min(n, target // 2). If more numbers are needed, continue picking from target upwards.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumPossibleSum(self, n: int, target: int) -> int:
        mod = 10**9 + 7
        m = target // 2
        if n <= m:
            return (n * (n + 1) // 2) % mod
        ans = m * (m + 1) // 2
        rem = n - m
        ans += (target + target + rem - 1) * rem // 2
        return ans % mod
```

variables: n: number of elements to select
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterative simulation with a set exceeds time limits when n is large.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary memory using direct mathematical formula.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate two closed-form arithmetic sequence sums modulo 10^9 + 7.
